card.name: Confirmatory test wording after false positives
card.fires_on: Words just before or inside the named confirmatory method, gas chromatography/mass spectrometry, in drug-label notes about false-positive urine screening tests. Typical spots are "such as", an opening parenthesis before GC/MS, or the slash inside the name.

modes.label: Lead-in to the method
modes.description: The words "such as" or "by" after "Confirmatory tests" that lead into the named method.
modes.example: Confirmatory tests, such<< as>> gas chromatography/mass spectrometry

modes.label: Parenthesis before abbreviation
modes.description: The opening parenthesis after mass spectrometry, just before GC/MS or GC-MS.
modes.example: The preferred confirmatory method is gas chromatography/mass spectrometry<< (>>GC/MS).

modes.label: Inside the method name
modes.description: The slash or join between gas chromatography and mass spectrometry.
